title: Hydrate before caffeine
message: Drink a glass of water before your first coffee or tea to start the day with a quick hydration win.

title: Take a five-minute walk
message: A short walk after a meal can help you reset, improve circulation, and build a stronger daily movement habit.

title: Reset your posture
message: Stand up, roll your shoulders, and look far away for 20 seconds to give your eyes and back a quick break.

title: Add protein early
message: Include a protein-rich breakfast to help steady energy and reduce afternoon snacking swings.

title: Pair meds with a habit
message: Tie medication reminders to an existing habit like brushing your teeth so it becomes easier to remember.

title: Create a wind-down cue
message: Dim the lights, lower the volume, and repeat the same bedtime steps to tell your body it is time to rest.

title: Keep water visible
message: Place a water bottle in your line of sight so drinking water becomes the easiest default choice.

title: Do a mobility snack
message: A 2-minute stretch session between tasks can keep energy up without needing a full workout.

title: Take a breathing reset
message: Try four slow breaths in and out to calm your nervous system and sharpen focus before the next task.

title: Turn a call into a walk
message: If a meeting does not need a screen, turn it into a walking call and collect steps without extra effort.

title: Pre-plan a healthy snack
message: Choose one snack ahead of time so you can stay consistent when hunger shows up later in the day.

title: Get morning light
message: A few minutes of morning sunlight can help set your rhythm and support better sleep later tonight.

title: Set a small step target
message: Pick a tiny step target for today and make it easy to win before the day gets busy.

title: Refill after activity
message: After exercise, drink water first so recovery starts immediately and your body stays ahead of fatigue.

title: Slow down meals
message: Pause halfway through a meal to notice fullness and help your body catch up with your appetite.

title: Reset your desk posture
message: Uncross your legs, plant your feet, and relax your shoulders to reduce tension while you work.

title: Walk after dinner
message: A relaxed evening walk can support digestion and create a clean transition into rest mode.

title: Notice one win
message: Write down one thing you did well today to keep momentum and reinforce healthy habits.

title: Take a phone-free break
message: Give your brain a short offline pause so you can come back with better attention and less fatigue.
